serves: RULES.md DECL-P4-10 item 2 (CU family detector parameters), frozen before any title-strip (w010-027) number
code: tools/sib/p4-pig-cu/cu.py (detector, scoring, on-sheet) and tools/sib/p4-pig-cu/inject.py (injection-recovery); sha256 in params_freeze.json

C1.role: control (known text, carbon ink) for E1
C1.T_g_source: p4-highz thresholds.json T_hi (control p99.9, frozen a9eead1)

E1.T_g_source: p4-highz thresholds.json T_hi (same scan as C1)

C2.T_g_source: t2_control.json: control C2 level-1 sheet-slab p99.9 of voxels > 0 (DECL-P4-6 rule)

grid.rule: origin (0,0), eligible >= 50 % mesh-valid over T x T

level_note: E1/C1 at level 0 (2.258 um). E2/C2 at level 1 (4.8 um in-plane mean of 2x2, 2.4 um in z), allowed by DECL-P4-10 item 2; this halves in-plane resolution and lowers small-grain sensitivity, which the injection-recovery measures on the same level.
slab_note: sheet = mesh surface +-20 um (E1/C1: 19 slices = +-20.3 um; E2/C2: 17 slices = +-19.2 um). gaps = offsets 60-120 um on both sides.

grain.connectivity: 3-D 26-connected, per chunk (components cut by chunk borders in-plane are split; voxel counts are unaffected)
grain.rule: voxels > T_g in 26-connected components with >= 2 voxels and z-extent <= 13 slices (~30 um); thicker bodies are 3-D inclusions, not a pen-stroke pigment layer. No lateral size cap. Each kept component counts once, at its bbox-centre px.

detector.summary: cell ~0.1 mm; statistic OCC = cell holds >= 1 grain centroid; stroke-scale mean over 3x3 cells (0.3 mm); local background = median over 31x31 cells (3.1 mm); sigma = max(1.4826 MAD(R), sqrt(max(B, 1/9)/9)); z > 3; 8-connected clusters of >= 4 cells with bbox extent 0.5-5 mm; score = sum z over cluster; tile score = max cluster score

nulls.rot90: np.rot90 of cell arrays (isotropic detector: equal by construction, reported as a check)

hotspot.threshold: thr_M = numpy.percentile(control tile scores + control rot-90 tile scores, 99) (linear); E1 uses C1, E2 uses C2
hotspot.rule: score > thr_M AND in-sheet fraction of the top cluster >= 0.8 AND not labelled-adjacent (p4-excl union flag)

onsheet.rule: f_in = E_sheet / (E_sheet + E_gap_lo + E_gap_hi), E = sum over cluster cells of (g - median g over ring cells outside the 2-cell-dilated cluster), each slab processed with the same grain rule; negative E clipped to 0; raw counts (sheet 19/17 slices vs gaps 27+27 / 26+26); depth-uniform baseline 0.26/0.25

injection.site_rule: tile uniform among eligible tiles, block centre uniform such that the block lies inside the tile, >= 90 % of block px mesh-valid (redraw up to 200 times)

F2.note: fine-ground (pale) Egyptian blue at D2 loading

injection.layer_position: centred on the mesh surface (centre slice), grain centres uniform within the layer

nominal.basis: v_air 41 + 11.4 x (109-41); Egyptian blue vs papyrus rho 0.5

injection.forward_model: occupancy by Monte-Carlo volume splat (64 pts/grain) on the native voxel grid (2.258 or 2.4 um), clipped to 1, Gaussian PSF sigma 0.7 voxel (3-D), v = clip(bg + occ (V - bg), 0, 255) rounded; level 1 = 2x2 in-plane mean of the level-0 forward values with bg = the level-1 voxel
injection.detection: a kept cluster (detector rule) with zsum > thr_M whose cells overlap the letter mask dilated by 2 cells
injection.false_positive: uninjected block: any kept cluster with zsum > thr_M
injection.plausible_level: D3 at conservative contrast (primary); D2 also reported. Sensitivity < 0.8 at D3-conservative => detector reported as INSENSITIVE (DECL-P4-10 item 3)
injection.detection_limit: lowest density level with sensitivity >= 0.8 (per material, per contrast)
injection.density_note: D1-D4 = plausible loading range (MEMO section 2); S1, S2, F1, F2 were added pre-freeze after a CONTROL-only code check (C1 sites 0-1) showed D1-D4 all recovered, so that a detection limit can be located. Grain median defaults to grain_diam_um.median unless grain_median_um is given.

design_history: Pre-freeze, on CONTROL C1 tiles r2 c0-c6 only: grain-voxel sum (G) and footprint (FP) statistics were heavy-tailed (permutation-null scores 190-1000), grain count NC had permutation null ~0-60, occupancy OCC (3x3) had permutation null 0 on all 7 tiles. OCC with 3x3 smoothing chosen. No title-strip number existed at that time.
